firm_note.text: Founded 2004 by Thomas Connelly; underwent a formal ownership transition in July 2023 in which Connelly transitioned majority ownership to Elizabeth Shabaker and newly-arrived Royce Ramey (who joined to open the Dallas office), with Connelly staying on as Chairman Emeritus/Investment Committee. A separate owner of record, 'Remington Revocable Trust' (dated 3/28/2014, 25-50% owner), has no identifiable human trustee/beneficiary in any independent source found — genuine search (press coverage of the 2023 transition, Versant's own announcements, general web search) turned up no connection between 'Remington' and any of the five people profiled here, and no public filing naming a trustee. This remains unresolved; do not guess.
firm_note.source: citybiz.co/article/446546 (Versant Capital Management Announces Ownership Transition, July 2023); AZ Big Media (azbigmedia.com/business/versant-capital-management-announces-ownership-change-and-expansion); Remington Trust link independently searched via web search with no corroborating result

Elizabeth Mollie Shabaker.bio_note: Co-CEO and CCO; with Versant since 2010 (15+ years) and now over a decade in executive leadership there. Before Versant, held leadership roles at GenSpring Family Offices and KPMG's Personal Financial Planning Practice. Holds CFP and CDC (Dementia Care Certified) designations — the latter reflecting specialized training to recognize early signs of Alzheimer's/dementia in client families. Known for a practice focus on women navigating major life transitions (career change, divorce, widowhood, inheritance) and serves as an ambassador for the Women's Leadership Alliance. Earned a Women's Choice Award for financial services to women. Sits on the ASU W.P. Carey Dean's Council and the Arizona Community Foundation advisory board. In July 2023 she and Royce Ramey took over majority ownership of the firm from founder Thomas Connelly.
Elizabeth Mollie Shabaker.bio_source: Women's Choice Award profile (womenschoiceaward.com/financial-advisors/shabaker); citybiz.co ownership transition article (citybiz.co/article/446546); corroborated via versantcm.com/team/elizabeth-shabaker

Royce Creighton Ramey.bio_note: Co-CEO and CIO; joined Versant in July 2023 specifically to establish its new Dallas office, and simultaneously took majority ownership alongside Elizabeth Shabaker as founder Thomas Connelly stepped back. Previously Managing Director and Chief Experience Officer at Tolleson Wealth Management in Dallas, and before that provided family-office services to ultra-high-net-worth families at GenSpring Family Offices in Phoenix. Texas Tech University graduate (BBA Finance and MS Finance, both summa cum laude); holds the CFA charter and is active in the CFA Institute's Dallas-Fort Worth Society. Serves on the board of the Perot Museum of Nature and Science, chairing its Investment Committee. Featured as a contributor on the Forbes Finance Council.
Royce Creighton Ramey.bio_source: Forbes Finance Council contributor profile (councils.forbes.com/profile/Royce-Ramey-Co-Owner-Co-CEO-Versant-Capital-Management); citybiz.co ownership transition article (citybiz.co/article/446546); corroborated via versantcm.com/team/royce-ramey

Thomas Joseph Connelly.bio_note: Founder of Versant Capital Management (2004) and, before that, co-founder of Keats, Connelly & Associates in 1990, where he was President and CIO — over 40 years in wealth management overall. Holds CFA and CFP designations; degrees include a Geology BA from University of St. Thomas, an MBA in Finance from Arizona State University, and an MS in Financial Planning from the College for Financial Planning. Repeatedly named one of the 'Top Financial Advisors in the U.S.' by Worth Magazine. In July 2023 transitioned majority ownership to Shabaker and Ramey, moving into the Chairman Emeritus/Investment Committee role. Also a shareholder/officer at Cross Border Tax & Accounting and an executive board member/shareholder of National Advisors Trust Company; serves on the Arizona State Retirement System board (fourth term).
Thomas Joseph Connelly.bio_source: citybiz.co ownership transition article (citybiz.co/article/446546); success.ai profile citing his founder history; corroborated via versantcm.com/team/tom-connelly

Jennifer Wagoner Kirksey.bio_note: Named COO of Versant in February 2025 (Dallas-based), overseeing operational strategy, technology integration, HR, and client service. Prior to Versant, spent 20+ years in wealth management, most recently as Deputy COO at Tolleson Wealth Management overseeing client operations, reporting, and bookkeeping. Holds a BBA in Finance and an MBA from Southern Methodist University. Recognized with Family Wealth Report's 'Women in Wealth Technology' award (2022) and named one of F2 Strategy's Top Women in Wealth Tech (2024); has spoken at the Pershing BNY Mellon Conference, SS&C Conference, and a ThinkAdvisor webcast. Serves on YPO Mustang Dallas and the Experience Innovation Board.
Jennifer Wagoner Kirksey.bio_source: Versant press release 'Jennifer Kirksey Named Chief Operating Officer at Versant Capital Management' (versantcm.com/jennifer-kirksey-named-chief-operating-officer-at-versant-capital-management), independently corroborated by LinkedIn profile and The Org (theorg.com/org/versant-capital-management-inc/org-chart/jennifer-kirksey)

Aimee Lynn Williams-Ramey.bio_note: Joined Versant as Chief Legal Officer in January 2026, per Versant's own listing. Independent sourcing shows a long, high-profile legal/HR executive career: SMU Dedman School of Law graduate (Summa Cum Laude, 2nd in class, Order of the Coif, Sumners Foundation Scholarship recipient), named to 'Best Lawyers in Dallas' (D Magazine, 2007-2009) and 'Texas Rising Star' (Texas Monthly Law & Politics, multiple years). Held Chief Legal Officer & Corporate Secretary role at Six Flags (from mid-2022), then moved to Texas Capital Bank as Deputy General Counsel (2024) and was promoted to Managing Director/Chief Human Resources Officer there (January 2025) — meaning her Versant listing (CLO, joined 01/2026) reflects a subsequent move from Texas Capital. On the shared surname with Royce Ramey: genuine search (LinkedIn, news announcements, general web search) found no source confirming or denying a spousal relationship — left unconfirmed, not assumed.
Aimee Lynn Williams-Ramey.bio_source: Texas Capital Bank leadership bio (texascapitalbank.com/who-we-are/people/leadership/aimee-williams-ramey); Six Flags CLO appointment coverage (via The Org: theorg.com/org/six-flags/org-chart/aimee-williams-ramey); LinkedIn profile

firm_note.text: Small, single-owner Scottsdale RIA. Boutique retirement-planning shop built around Kyle Spahn personally.

Kyle Robert Spahn.bio_note: Founder and sole Managing Member of Spahn Wealth & Retirement; roughly 18-20 years as a financial planner. Holds the CFP designation and a degree from Arizona State University. Built the firm around long-term client relationships and retirement planning, with an investment approach grounded in Modern Portfolio Theory with tactical adjustments.
Kyle Robert Spahn.bio_source: SmartAdvisorMatch advisor network profile (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-firm-network/arizona/spahn-wealth-retirement-llc-285932); LinkedIn profile

firm_note.text: Scottsdale-based advisory shop; some third-party trackers (HedgeLists, Hedge Fund Contacts) categorize Harmony as hedge-fund-related, suggesting a less typical RIA structure than a standard retail wealth manager.

Alan Edward Rosenfield.bio_note: Founder and Managing Director of Harmony Asset Management, with the firm since 2001 (24+ years) and roughly 21+ years of overall financial services experience. Sits on the firm's Portfolio Management Team and Investment Committee. Holds Series 63 and 65 registrations, registered to practice in Arizona and Florida. His professional philosophy, per the firm's own site, emphasizes giving clients full access to the team and its network regardless of asset size.
Alan Edward Rosenfield.bio_source: AdvisorCheck regulatory profile (advisorcheck.com/advisor/1129174-alan-edward-rosenfield-harmony-asset-management-llc-scottsdale-arizona); Indyfin advisor profile; LinkedIn

firm_note.text: Mesa-based RIA founded by Mark Rauguth in 2013; built out of a long individual advisory career rather than a team-based firm.

Mark Edward Rauguth.bio_note: Managing Member and CCO of Immaculate Wealth Management, which he founded in Mesa in 2013; over 36 years total in financial services. Began his career in 1986 at American Express Financial Advisors as a registered representative; in 1997 moved to Raymond James Financial Services as an investment adviser and branch manager, building a higher-net-worth and small-business practice. In 2000, while still at RJFS, founded a second entity, Precision Investments, Inc., to handle clients' insurance and annuity needs. Later earned the CFP designation. Holds Series 63 and 65 registrations, licensed in Arizona, California, and Texas.
Mark Edward Rauguth.bio_source: Indyfin advisor profile (indyfin.com/financial-advisor/arizona/mesa/mark-rauguth-1564114); Wealthminder profile; LinkedIn

firm_note.text: Founded by Curt Thompson and Donald Callaghan, who are described as pioneers of the Outsourced Chief Investment Officer (OCIO) model, having built Hirtle Callaghan into the first OCIO firm to surpass $20 billion in AUM before launching this firm. Employee-owned, with offices in Scottsdale AZ, Jupiter FL, and Durham NC.
firm_note.source: Firm website (gsisus.com/history-of-gsis); corroborated by WealthMinder.com advisor profile for Donald Callaghan

Curt Randall Thompson.bio_note: Managing Partner and co-founder with 31 years in the OCIO industry. Spent 23 years at Hirtle, Callaghan & Co. (the first-ever OCIO firm in America) before co-founding Global Strategic in 2018 alongside Don Callaghan. Holds a BS (1989) and MBA (1994) from Penn State University. Oversees the firm's largest private wealth, family office, and nonprofit institutional relationships and sits on the investment policy committee.
Curt Randall Thompson.bio_source: Firm website (gsisus.com/team/curt-thompson, gsisus.com/history-of-gsis); corroborated via WealthMinder.com and LinkedIn confirming Hirtle Callaghan tenure and OCIO pioneer narrative

Donald Edward Callaghan.bio_note: Managing Partner and co-founder; CRD 38501 reflects a long career (37+ years in the industry per WealthMinder). Co-built Hirtle, Callaghan & Co. into the first OCIO firm to exceed $20 billion in AUM before launching Global Strategic in 2015/2018. Education per LinkedIn: The Wharton School (1971-1973) and an earlier degree (1964-1968). Active in market commentary and published financial media pieces on active manager selection.
Donald Edward Callaghan.bio_source: Firm website (gsisus.com/history-of-gsis); corroborated by WealthMinder.com advisor profile (wealthminder.com/financial-advisors-scottsdale-AZ/donald-callaghan/368252) confirming CRD, tenure, and Scottsdale office, plus LinkedIn for education/activity

Nicholas Guido Botticelli.bio_note: Chief Investment Strategist and Head of the Southeast Office, with over two decades managing large, complex investment portfolios. Most recently VP of Investment Strategy in the Investment Office at Exelon Corporation, leading investment strategy, asset allocation, hedge funds, and private credit across Exelon's $43 billion in assets. Before that, Director of Investment Strategy at Hirtle Callaghan, and spent 17 years at Verizon Investment Management Corporation as Executive Director of Global Investments. Attended Pace University.
Nicholas Guido Botticelli.bio_source: IC Research consultant database profile (ic-research.com/investment-consultant/nicholas-nick-botticelli) and LinkedIn, corroborating career history beyond the firm website

Matthew Keith Underwood.bio_note: Holds CFA, CAIA, and CDAA (Certified Digital Asset Advisor) designations. Earned a Bachelor's in Business Information Systems from Arizona State University (2009) and an MBA in Finance from the University of Arizona's Eller College of Management (2012). Independent sources list his current role as Director of Investments and Head of Research & Portfolio Management (differs from the CCO title in our ownership records — noting the discrepancy rather than silently resolving it). Prior experience at The Vanguard Group, BB&T, and Retirement Wealth Advisors. Serves as Past President/Advisor to the Executive Board of CFA Society North Carolina, a 1,500+ member professional organization, after previously serving as its President.
Matthew Keith Underwood.bio_source: LinkedIn and U.S. News Financial Advisors profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/matthew-underwood-5907386), both corroborating credentials and CFA Society NC leadership beyond the firm website

Hana Callaghan.bio_note: Genuine effort made to confirm identity and relationship to Donald Callaghan, but results are ambiguous. A person named Hana Callaghan living in Scottsdale, AZ has a corporate background in wealth management, estate planning, and family wealth transfers at Goldman Sachs, and later became a certified life/executive coach (Erickson International, 2019) running 'InSight Coach, LLC.' However, her own coaching-site bio does not mention Global Strategic Investment Solutions, Donald Callaghan, or any spousal relationship — it only states she lives in Scottsdale with 'our 8 year old daughter.' No independent source directly ties this Hana Callaghan to the firm or confirms she is Donald Callaghan's spouse/family member — not assumed.
Hana Callaghan.bio_source: hanacallaghan.com/me (coaching bio); general web search snippets referencing a Scottsdale-based Hana Callaghan with a Goldman Sachs background — identity/relationship to Donald Callaghan NOT independently confirmed

firm_note.text: Founded by Dawn Dahlby-Jurkovich, positioned as a concierge fiduciary practice blending financial strategy with behavioral finance, with a stated focus on serving women and their families. Dawn splits time between Minnesota and Arizona offices.
firm_note.source: Firm website (relevefinancialgroup.com); corroborated by Forbes Finance Council profile

Dawn Deborah Jurkovich.bio_note: President and Founding Partner of Releve Financial Group. Over 20 years of experience; holds CFP, CRPC, and BFA (Behavioral Financial Advisor) designations — described as the nation's first certified Behavioral Financial Advisor. Created the 'WELLthy360' approach and authored 'Live WELLthy.' Recognized as a nationally recognized keynote speaker on values-aligned wealth and leadership. Also serves as CFO and Designer for a real estate venture, D2 Legacy, LLC. Listed as a member of the Forbes Finance Council.
Dawn Deborah Jurkovich.bio_source: Forbes Finance Council member profile (councils.forbes.com/profile/Dawn-Dahlby-Jurkovich) — independent, non-firm-website source confirming credentials, authorship, and speaking recognition; corroborated by Wealthminder.com and firm website

Kimberly Karen Bannwarth.bio_note: Chief Compliance Officer; also holds title Managing Director/Vice President per LinkedIn/ZoomInfo. Holds CRPC (Chartered Retirement Planning Counselor) designation. Prior roles in Client Services management at NorthRock Partners and Ameriprise Financial. Holds a Master's degree from St. Cloud State University and a Bachelor of Music Education from the University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire — a notable career pivot from music education into wealth management operations/compliance.
Kimberly Karen Bannwarth.bio_source: LinkedIn and ZoomInfo profile, corroborating career history and education beyond the firm website

firm_note.text: Small independent RIA in Cave Creek, AZ; wholly owned and operated by founder Jeffrey Jones, offering investment management, retirement, tax, and insurance planning.

Jeffrey Michael Jones.bio_note: Managing Member, Principal, and CCO (100% owner) of Foothills Advisors. Arizona State University graduate. Began his financial career over a decade before founding the firm, starting in corporate finance at Wells Fargo/Wells Fargo Advisors, then gaining experience at two independent local advisory firms before founding Foothills Advisors. Focus areas include investment management, retirement planning, tax planning/preparation, strategic financing, and insurance design. Lives in Phoenix with his wife Amber and four children; enjoys guitar, running, cycling, and golf.
Jeffrey Michael Jones.bio_source: Firm website (foothillsadvisors.com/jeff) for narrative detail; corroborated by LinkedIn (search snippet showing ASU education, Foothills Advisors role, and Greater Phoenix Area location matching the firm bio) and SmartAdvisorMatch listing confirming sole ownership/CCO status

firm_note.text: Founded December 1991 by former military/commercial pilots John E. Foster II and James Hughes (originally HFG Asset Allocation Service), renamed Total Investment Management in 1998. Specializes in financial and retirement planning exclusively for airline industry professionals (pilots, flight attendants). Over 1,000 aviation families served, ~$1.35B AUM. Family-owned: John Foster (Chairman/founder) and his son Todd Foster (CEO) are the principal owners.
firm_note.source: Firm website (timgt.com/company); corroborated by LinkedIn and ZoomInfo listing

John Edward Foster.bio_note: Founder and Chairman. Born April 2, 1944, on Staten Island, NY. Earned a B.S. in Biology from Wagner College, briefly taught General Science, then joined the U.S. Air Force, earning his pilot wings in February 1968. Served four years as a pilot in Vietnam and various U.S. postings, and was awarded the Distinguished Flying Cross. Later worked as a Marketing Rep for Hallmark Cards, flew for Eastern Airlines, earned a Master's in Accounting and Taxation from Fairleigh Dickinson University during a furlough, and worked at McDonnell Douglas writing crew procedures for the C-17 aircraft before founding the firm in 1991. Confirmed to be Todd Foster's father.
John Edward Foster.bio_source: Firm website (timgt.com/company) for detailed military/career narrative; corroborated by LinkedIn profile ('Principal — Total Investment Management') confirming his role and firm founding history

Todd Michael Foster.bio_note: Chief Executive Officer; confirmed son of founder John E. Foster II. Born and raised in Emerson, NJ. B.S. in Accounting from Rutgers University's Janice H. Levin School of Business. Worked at Ernst & Young LLP in the National 401(k)/Pension Department during and after college, in audit and real estate consulting roles, and obtained his CPA license there, including work on IPOs. Joined Total Investment Management in January 1998, earned the Accredited Investment Fiduciary (AIF) designation in 2009, and sits on the firm's investment committee. Hosts TIMGT's Weekly Market Update video series, presenting market recaps for the firm's airline-industry client base.
Todd Michael Foster.bio_source: Firm website (timgt.com/company) for career narrative; corroborated by ZoomInfo (Chief Executive Officer at Total Investment Management) and independently-referenced Weekly Market Update video series found in web search

Brett William Pohl.bio_note: Genuine effort made but no independent source could be found confirming a Brett Pohl as Chief Compliance Officer at Total Investment Management. The only substantive Brett Pohl found in search results (LinkedIn: 'Director, Compliance Services' at Key Bridge Compliance, based in East Bridgewater, Massachusetts) does not mention any affiliation with TIMGT and is presumed to be a different individual given the geographic mismatch. No firm bio, LinkedIn profile, or press mention tying a Brett Pohl to TIMGT/Scottsdale was located.
Brett William Pohl.bio_source: No independent source found; searches of LinkedIn, general web, and SEC IAPD via web search did not surface a confirmed profile
